items.headline: $PONS Rug Pull: $18.4M Extracted on Robinhood Chain
items.summary: An onchain analyst tied $18.4M in memecoin extractions to one coordinated rug-pull. 10 $PONS V2 launches exempted insider wallets from the anti-sniping tax, letting them scoop most of each supply.

items.headline: $AAVE Stock-Token Loans Carry Weekend Price-Gap Risk
items.summary: $AAVE's live tokenized stock lending markets expose USDC lenders to weekend price gaps while equity markets are closed — a new DeFi use case with fresh risk.

items.headline: $JUP's Kash Dhanda on DeFi's Mainstream Path
items.summary: Jupiter Exchange's Kash Dhanda lays out how DeFi can attract mainstream users, spotlighting Solana's top DEX aggregator $JUP and its growth push.

items.headline: $STRK Challenge Slashes Quantum-Safe Compute by 79%
items.summary: StarkWare's AI-assisted contest cut the compute estimate for quantum-safe Bitcoin proofs by 79%, targeting offchain GPU work — a big technical win for the $STRK ecosystem.

items.headline: Buterin Maps $ETH's Post-Hegota 'World Computer'
items.summary: Vitalik Buterin outlined Ethereum's path beyond the Hegota upgrade — censorship resistance, wallet flexibility and proof aggregation — a major roadmap moment for $ETH.
